name: Ukraine
summary: A 'small amount' for own use is an administrative offence (fine, community work or up to 15 days' arrest); more is a crime. Many limits are tiny (cocaine 0.02 g, LSD 10 µg). Medical cannabis legal since Aug 2024.

emergency.poisonControlNote: No national public poison hotline could be verified; call 103 or 112.

callingForHelp: No Good Samaritan law. Medical confidentiality applies, but police may be involved. Voluntarily starting drug treatment exempts from criminal liability for basic possession (CC art. 309(4)).
drugChecking: No established public drug checking service is known; its legal status is unclear.

lsd.note: 'Small amount' is only 0.00001 g (10 µg), less than one tab, so typical amounts are a crime (fine, probation or restriction of liberty; more: prison).

mushrooms.note: Small amount is ≤0.5 g of mushroom (≤0.01 g psilocybin), below a typical dose; above that is a crime. Spores are sold.

dmt.note: Up to 0.15 g: administrative fine, community work or up to 15 days' arrest. More: crime (fine/probation; 1.5 g+ up to 3 yrs).

mescaline.note: Small amount is ≤0.15 g, less than one dose; above that is a crime.

dox.note: DOB, DOC: up to 0.15 g is an administrative offence; above that is a crime (1.5 g+ up to 3 yrs).

nbomes.note: 25I/25B/25C-NBOMe: up to 0.15 g is an administrative offence; above that is a crime.

2c-x.note: 2C-B 'small amount' is only 0.01 g (below one dose), so typical possession is a crime.

2c-t-x.note: 2C-T-2 and 2C-T-7: small amount only 0.01 g, so typical possession is a crime.

5-meo-xxt.note: 5-MeO-DMT: up to 0.15 g is an administrative offence (5-MeO-DIPT/-DALT: 0.015 g). Tryptamine derivatives are covered generically.

cannabis.note: Up to 5 g herb / 0.5 g resin: admin offence. More: crime (500 g+: up to 3 yrs). Medical cannabis on prescription since Aug 2024 law.

ketamine.note: Controlled medicine. Without a prescription up to 1 g is an administrative offence; more is a crime.

mxe.note: Up to 0.15 g: administrative offence; more: crime.

dxm.note: Explicitly excluded from the controlled lists; sold as a cough medicine (prescription/OTC status not verified).

nitrous.note: Not on the controlled-substance lists; no specific consumer rules were found.

amphetamines.note: Amphetamine or methamphetamine up to 0.15 g: admin offence; more: crime (1.5 g+ up to 3 yrs). ADHD stimulants are tightly controlled.

mdma.note: Up to 0.15 g MDMA (about one pill): admin offence. More: crime; 1.5 g+ 'large' (up to 3 yrs).

cocaine.note: 'Small amount' is only 0.02 g; above that is a crime (fine/probation; 1 g+ 'large', up to 3 yrs).

caffeine.note: Legal and not a controlled substance.

alcohol.note: Legal from 18; sale to minors is prohibited. Martial-law curfews and local sales limits may apply.

ghb/gbl.note: GHB and GBL: 'small amount' is only 0.5 g (less than one dose), so typical possession is a crime.

opioids.note: Heroin small amount is 0.005 g, so any real amount is a crime; methadone 0.02 g. Prescription opioids need a prescription.

tramadol.note: Listed narcotic, prescription-only. Without a prescription up to 0.5 g is an admin offence; more is a crime.

benzodiazepines.note: Controlled, prescription-only. Small-amount limits are low (diazepam 0.1 g, alprazolam 0.01 g), so ~10+ tablets without a prescription can be a crime.

maois.note: Harmala alkaloids/Syrian rue are not on the controlled lists; pharmaceutical MAOIs are Rx-only. DMT in ayahuasca is controlled.
